scenario.title: Battle of Vitsi
intro.text:
BATTLE OF VITSI - 9 SEP 1948

Lake Kastoria, West Macedonia

It has not gone unnoticed that our main forces have retreated into the Vitsi mountains. With a new offensive the enemy wants us to deathblow here. But he underestimated our remaining strength and attack with only weak forces. After we have fool him with our withdraw he is now trapped! Destroy the enemy troops - a victory is urgently needed in order to maintain the morale of our forces!

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE In this mission the AI has the first turn!
header.act: ACT IV — THE WAR IN THE MOUNTAINS
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-26-0-briliant.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.reaction-26-0-briliant.text: The required formations cleared the Grammos trap in order and enough positions held to disguise the movement until late. The DSE remains an army, though the massif does not remain its frontier.
line.reaction-26-1-victory-tactical.text: The DSE escaped Grammos with losses and scattered rear guards. Vitsi receives surviving formations, hospitals, and a strategic dispute sharpened by every missing unit.
line.reaction-26-2-lose.speaker: Nikos Zachariadis
line.reaction-26-2-lose.text: The Grammos position broke without the required force escaping in order. The survivors at Vitsi will be rebuilt under directives that call the defeat proof of insufficient resolve.
line.callback-0.speaker: Nikos Zachariadis
line.callback-0.text: Grammos proved the DSE could defend a front. It also gave the National Army a fixed address for every new aircraft and gun. We cannot keep only the first lesson.
line.callback-1.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.callback-1.text: The Grammos corridors delivered an army instead of a martyr's list. Headquarters still speaks of abandoned ground when it means my command. You bought the formations time, not forgiveness.
line.callback-2.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.callback-2.text: The Konitsa mortar group stayed together and gave Grammos one battery whose crews understood retreat as well as fire.
line.callback-3.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.callback-3.text: Konitsa's mortar group was divided among the core. It left no famous battery, but more companies at Grammos possessed useful fire.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.earned-decision.text: The Grammos rear guard came through with its local couriers still answering roll call. It can remain a partisan detachment, or vanish into formations which need its stores more than its name.
line.earned-decision.choice.keep-grammos: Keep the Grammos rear guard as a partisan detachment.
Add an experienced seven-strength partisan unit.
line.earned-decision.choice.rebuild-afte: Distribute its veterans, fuel, and ammunition through the core.
Give every formation 5 experience and fully refuel and rearm the core.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.earned-a-response.text: Keep the detachment. It knows how to leave a closing road without losing the people who make the road useful.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.earned-b-response.text: Distribute it. The caches go to the weak battalions; the couriers keep their routes. Survival does not require a separate flag.
line.scene-0.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.scene-0.text: The Prespa replacements include women who voted in the Free Greece elections before Athens gave women a national ballot. The roster calls three of them auxiliaries. They commanded sections at Grammos.
line.scene-1.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.scene-1.text: Then correct the roster. I need the ranks they earned and every pair of boots they brought with them.
line.scene-2.speaker: Nikos Zachariadis
line.scene-2.text: Our comrades abroad fear that Greece could open a war none of them can contain. They praise the DSE and inspect every crate as though it carried the first shot. We must show them an army capable of a result.
line.scene-3.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.scene-3.text: Then I plan with the crates that crossed the border, not the resolutions that did. Give me food routes, guides, and two nights without aircraft; then the towns become vulnerable.
line.decision.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.decision.text: Do we mass the remaining guns against Korisos and Dispilio now, or rebuild the routes and local cells before the assault?
line.decision.choice.counterattack-the-t: Mass the surviving guns for a direct counterattack on Korisos and Dispilio.
Give infantry and artillery 15 experience and restore the core to at least nine strength with full ammunition.
line.decision.choice.rebuild-the-network: Rebuild the mountain routes and local cells before assaulting the objectives.
Give infantry and reconnaissance 15 experience and fully refuel and rearm the core.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: I'll find the twenty-five pairs. I cannot find another battalion if the guns fail to move after it.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Nikos Zachariadis
line.choice-a-1.text: The attack begins before the National Army turns its advance into a permanent line. The people must see the DSE return, not merely hear that it survived.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Nikos Zachariadis
line.choice-b-0.text: Delay has become your answer to every demand for a result. If the local cells do not re-form, this operation will be remembered as preparation for nothing.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Markos Vafiadis
line.choice-b-1.text: I accept that. Light groups go first with couriers and supply parties. We attack when the government posts discover their rear is no longer quiet.
